title: mail-server /query handlers ignore sort collation
description: RFC 8620 §5.5 (unsupportedSort): 'includes a property the server does not support sorting on or a collation method it does not recognise'. Mailbox/query, EmailSubmission/query and SieveScript/query (crate-jmap-mail-server/src/{mailbox,submission,sieve}.rs) parse Comparator.collation but never check it, and the server advertises no collationAlgorithms. Found while fixing JMAP-6hv3. Decide: reject unrecognised collations with unsupportedSort, or advertise and honour a set.
close_reason: batch 22: implemented, adversarially verified, CI green at 20645f57, pushed
